title: Multiplicity-One Structure in Graded Zero-Divisor Graphs
summary: Let \(H\) be a multiplicative group, \(R\) a commutative \(H\)-graded ring, and \(M\) a nonzero finitely generated gr-semisimple \(H\)-graded \(R\)-module. We assume that \(M\) admits a fixed decomposition into powers of gr-simple modules with pairwise distinct annihilators, each repeated block carrying the componentwise grading. For a nonzero homogeneous element \(x\), we compute the colon ideal \((Rx:M)\) and show that it is determined by the multiplicity-one blocks on which \(x\) has a nonzero component.
